submitted.rationale: XRD at index 13 (Pb0.34Sb0.66, close to PbSb2O6 stoichiometry) shows the strongest trigonal PbSb2O6 reflections (Q≈1.37, 1.80, 2.98, 4.12). It was the only one of the three measured compositions with a positive EQE (4.5e-4 %). All measured values are near zero, though, so this library looks like a weak photoanode system at 3.2 eV.

rejected.reason: Mixed PbSb2O6 + Pb-rich phase; measured EQE -8.3e-4 %, effectively zero
Pb-rich phase (dominant Q≈2.045 peak, as at index 4); measured EQE -2.1e-3 %
Sb-oxide-dominated XRD (Q≈1.06, 2.11, 2.62); wide-gap Sb oxide unlikely to absorb 3.2 eV photons; not measured because of budget
